title: The Last Verdict Anew
author: Sable Winterbourne
blurb: Vesper Voss, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
